prompt: Create one strict orthographic TOP projection of this upright color wheel on its gold stand. The wheel disk stands vertically, so from the top it must be edge-on and appear only as a very thin straight gold rim/edge running through the center of the circular stand. The disk face, its spokes and full wheel circle must be completely hidden by foreshortening; do NOT draw a circular decorated wheel face in this view. The gold circular stand/base is visible as a round floor footprint, matching the accepted BOTTOM footprint. Show just the small top finial and modest colored orb projections around the base edge as physically visible. The current RIGHT view is the profile guide: keep wheel depth thin (approximately the 104px side-width scale versus 176px base diameter in normalized bounds). Source is primary for colors and object. Prior TOP candidate is specifically rejected for showing the broad face. Transparent 256x256 pixel-art image, centered, no perspective, no extra details.
